# Search UX & Data Scoping Checklist: جستجوی یکپارچه

**Purpose**: سنجش کیفیت نوشتار نیازمندی‌های کادر جستجو (تجربه کاربری، دسترس‌پذیری) و محدوده داده/یکسان‌سازی فارسی، پیش از بازبینی PR
**Created**: 2026-10-30
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [plan.md](../plan.md) · [contracts/search-api.md](../contracts/search-api.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

Defaults used (no answers in this session): Depth = Standard; Audience = Reviewer (PR); Focus = (1) search box UX & accessibility, (2) data scoping & Persian matching.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Is it specified which date each type shows (date recorded vs. due date vs. event date)? [Gap, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK002 Is the snippet length, and what the snippet shows when the match is only in the title, specified? [Gap, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK003 Is the order of groups relative to each other defined, not only the order within a group? [Gap, Spec §FR-005, §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK004 Are the destination page and tab defined for every type listed in FR-002? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004, research R8]
- [ ] CHK005 Is it stated which pages must reveal the chosen item and which only open the page? [Gap, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK006 Are the loading, no-result and unavailable states each given wording or content? [Completeness, Spec §FR-011, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK007 Is the behavior of «بیشتر» once a group is expanded (collapse, a second expansion past 20) specified? [Gap, Spec §FR-005]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK008 Is «پس از مکث در تایپ» quantified with a delay? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK009 Is «تکه‌ای از متن پیرامون کلمه» bounded (characters, which word when several match)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK010 Is «کلمه» defined (separators, minimum length, maximum number of words)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK011 Is the set of normalized characters listed exhaustively, including «آ/ا», «ى», tatweel and diacritics? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK012 Is the one-character rule stated in normalized terms (e.g., «ی‌» or a digit alone)? [Clarity, Edge Cases]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK013 Is FR-002 («شرکت‌ها و سازمان‌ها») consistent with Clarification Q1 (organizations the person is only a member of)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-002, Clarifications]
- [ ] CHK014 Are the types the assistant covers (FR-009) consistent with the types in the search box, including any type with no page to open? [Consistency, Spec §FR-009, data-model `palette`]
- [ ] CHK015 Is «همه کلمه‌ها باید باشند» (FR-006) consistent with what the assistant may do when that finds nothing? [Conflict, Spec §FR-006, research R5]
- [ ] CHK016 Do the existing «ایجاد» and «صفحه‌ها» groups of the box have a defined place relative to the new record groups? [Consistency, Spec §FR-001]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK017 Is SC-002's «۵٬۰۰۰ مورد» defined (one type or spread across types; the device and network assumed)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK018 Can SC-001 («کمتر از ۱۰ ثانیه») be measured without a user study, or is a proxy defined? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK019 Does SC-006 define the set of assistant questions and what counts as «اشاره به مورد درست»? [Measurability, Spec §SC-006]

## Scenario & Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK020 Are requirements defined for a type that fails on the server while others succeed (partial results)? [Coverage, Exception Flow]
- [ ] CHK021 Is the behavior defined when the chosen item was deleted between search and opening? [Coverage, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK022 Is the behavior defined when the person signs out or switches accounts while the box is open? [Coverage, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK023 Are queries made only of punctuation, `%`, `_` or emoji addressed? [Edge Case, Gap]
- [ ] CHK024 Is a very long query (pasted paragraph) addressed? [Edge Case, Gap, contracts §Request]

## Non-Functional: Security, Accessibility, Mobile

- [ ] CHK025 Is it stated that counts («و N مورد دیگر») must also exclude other people's items? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK026 Is it specified that identity comes only from the session, never from a request parameter? [Gap, Spec §FR-008, contracts §Guarantees]
- [ ] CHK027 Are records the person can read but does not own (organization members) explicitly in or out of scope? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008, Clarifications]
- [ ] CHK028 Is what the screen reader announces (count wording, when it changes) specified? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK029 Are keyboard requirements defined for «بیشتر» and for moving between groups? [Coverage, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK030 Is the mobile entry point (which control in the top bar) and the box's size on a 390px screen specified? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK031 Is the assumption that lists kept as one document per person stay small enough to scan per query stated and bounded? [Assumption, research R3]
- [ ] CHK032 Is the exclusion of attachment contents and health numbers reflected in FR-002's type list without contradiction? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- 32 items; 30 of 32 (94%) carry a spec, plan or contract reference
